title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: WinStar World Casino, Thackerville | 2017
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Global Event Center, situated at the Winstar World Casino in Thackerville, Oklahoma, USA, on 4 November 2017.

It was the 13th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s US tour, which lasted for 21 dates in October and November 2017.

Starr had previously performed at the WinStar World Casino on 5 July 2014. He returned there on 13 October 2023.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
